wf-ink.purpose: the default room, page background and VitePress background (`--vp-c-bg`). Dark value is `#0a0a0a`; light mode inverts it to `#f7f7f5`.

wf-ink-raised.purpose: hover and raised dark surfaces (`#141414`; light mode `#ffffff`).

wf-ink-rule.purpose: dividers and structural rules (`#2a2a2a`; light mode `#d8d8d4`).

wf-optic.purpose: main sign text and banner lettering. Dark value is `#ffffff`; light mode inverts it to `#0a0a0a`.

wf-optic-dim.purpose: secondary labels on the substrate (`#a3a3a3`; light mode `#5c5c5c`).

wf-track-a.purpose: `#1f4bff`, with `--wf-on-track-a: #ffffff`. Used for Copilot Studio and the home banner track tint.

wf-track-d.purpose: `#c8ff00`, with `--wf-on-track-d: #101400`. Used for selection, focus, tickets and high-signal strips.

wf-track-e.purpose: `#ff6b00`, with `--wf-on-track-e: #1a0a00`. Added when the programme outgrew four rooms.

wf-on-track-a.purpose: The measured ink for text sitting on Track A.

wf-on-track-b.purpose: The measured ink for text sitting on Track B.

wf-on-track-c.purpose: The measured ink for text sitting on Track C.

wf-on-track-d.purpose: The measured ink for text sitting on Track D.

wf-on-track-e.purpose: The measured ink for text sitting on Track E.

venue.purpose: Huge record and display moments such as event counts.

sign.purpose: The signage register: uppercase, wide, tight-tracked. Every page title and navigable label.

read.purpose: The reading exception. Blog posts and talk abstracts, in sentence case at a 68ch measure.

label.purpose: Small caps-tracked labels, dim optic unless sitting on a track field.

motion.name: wf-motion
motion.purpose: The only duration. Signage changes state, it does not travel.

motion.name: wf-ease
motion.purpose: Cut, hard and directional; nothing overshoots or bounces.

motion.name: arrow-advance
motion.purpose: The only positional move in the system: a sign row’s terminal arrow steps forward on hover and focus.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion every transition collapses to an instant state change.

components.name: Sign Row
components.description: The atom of the world: a full-width directional sign with a colour tab, a cut label, an optional note and a terminal arrow. Never shorter than a thumb.
components.html: Speaking recordEvery event, and what is coming up next.→

narrative.overview:
Wayfinding is built from one thesis: the site is the venue and every page is a sign. It owns the world of conference environmental graphics: matte vinyl colour fields, optic-white cut lettering, oversized directional arrows, track-letter tiles, and full-bleed hanging-banner photography. The form seed is `8b56bdc1`, candidate 3, and the direction contract is shipped into every page head from `src/.vitepress/contract.ts`.

The site rejects the usual developer-advocate layout of portrait, bio line, feature cards, gradient hero and timeline. It also rejects an editorial broadsheet. The user is often holding a phone in a dark room after a session, so navigation is not decoration: rows, tracks, doors and arrows are the interface. The one recorded staging idea, `converging-pair`, is used only on the session placard via `SpeakerCard`, where two speaker plates on one baseline become one billed session block.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed near-black substrate with optic lettering: `--wf-ink`, `--wf-optic`, `--wf-ink-rule`.
Track colours are fields, not accent text: `--wf-track-a` through `--wf-track-e` carry `--wf-on-track-*` ink.
Every navigable thing tries to become a sign row with a terminal arrow.
Reading content gets an explicit exception: prose keeps the venue but leaves the signage register.
Motion is cut, hard and directional; signage does not bounce.

rules.name: The Contrast Law Rule
rules.body: Track colours are field colours carrying white or black text; never set small track-coloured text on the substrate. The measured shipping pairs are Track A `#1F4BFF` on white at 5.99:1, Track B `#00C2A8` with `#04231F` at 7.34:1, Track C `#D6203A` on white at 5.09:1, Track D `#C8FF00` with `#101400` at 15.83:1, and Track E `#FF6B00` with `#1A0A00` at 6.76:1.

rules.name: The Red Correction Rule
rules.body: The original red `#FF3D57` measured only 3.47:1 and was darkened to `#D6203A`. Do not restore the brighter red.

rules.name: The Marker Rule
rules.body: Every underline, tab and rule that marks a navigable thing waits in `--wf-marker` and lights `--wf-marker-live` on hover and focus. Standing still the marker is anatomy, not decoration; live, it is the way out. A row that genuinely belongs to a track overrides the live colour with that track's own. Markers sitting on a saturated track field are the one exception and stay `currentColor`, because a grey rule on Track A blue disappears. This rule governs the nav, the sign tabs, prose links, the `clear` controls and every board exit.

rules.name: The Marker Ink Rule
rules.body: `--wf-marker-live` is a *marker* colour, not an ink one. Track A on the dark substrate measures 3.31:1, which passes the 3:1 floor for a 2px rule and fails the 4.5:1 floor for text. Wherever the live colour is a word rather than a rule — the nav's current and hovered items — it must use `--wf-marker-live-ink` (`#4D74FF`, 4.96:1). Light mode needs no lift: flat Track A on paper measures 5.99:1.

rules.name: The No Fade On Fields Rule
rules.body: Opacity must never be used to dim text sitting on a track field. `0.85` opacity dropped Track C to 4.01:1 and Track A to 4.74:1. Signage separates by scale and weight, never by fade.

rules.name: The Reading Exception Rule
rules.body: Blog posts and talk abstracts drop out of the signage register into a real reading measure, currently `--wf-measure: 68ch` and about 623px rendered. They keep the substrate, track colour and rules, but use sentence case. Caps-at-venue-scale governs wayfinding, not prose.

rules.name: The Specificity Trap Rule
rules.body: `.VPPage .vp-doc > div` suppresses the reading measure on full-bleed signage pages, while `.VPDoc .vp-doc > div` applies it to prose. Do not use a plain `.vp-doc > div` measure rule; it loses to the higher-specificity suppression.

rules.name: The Navbar Offset Rule
rules.body: Below 960px the VitePress navbar is in normal flow; at and above 960px it is fixed. Therefore `.VPContent` gets `padding-top: var(--vp-nav-height)` only inside `@media (min-width: 960px)`. Applying that padding at all widths double-offsets mobile; applying it nowhere crops signage under the navbar.

rules.name: The Door Rule
rules.body: `/r/` resource pages are full-viewport track fields (`background: var(--track); color: var(--on-track)`) with safe-area padding and a max-width sheet of 44rem. They must stay minimal because Product Principle 1 is “The QR path is the critical path.”

rules.name: The No Shadow Vocabulary Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce ambient cards, glows or soft elevation to solve hierarchy. Use a rule (`1px` or `3px`), a track field, a larger sign register, or a directional arrow.

dos: Do use `--track` and `--on-track` together whenever a track field carries text.
Do keep navigable objects as full-width rows or doors with arrows and at least `--wf-tap` height.
Do use `BannerImage` for photography, with track tint and scrim intact.
Do preserve `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` and keep motion to instant state changes or directional arrow slides.
Do keep prose in `.wf-read` / `.VPDoc .vp-doc > div` at `--wf-measure` instead of stretching it across the venue.
donts: Don't use small track-coloured text on `--wf-ink`; track colours are fields, not link colours.
Don't dim text on track fields with opacity; the measured failures are known.
Don't put photography on `/r/` resource pages, or make a resource page wait on decorative assets.
Don't use circular portraits, soft cards, gradients or stock VitePress ornaments inside committed Wayfinding surfaces.
Don't apply `padding-top: var(--vp-nav-height)` to `.VPContent` below 960px, and don't remove it above 960px.
